daily_comment.summary: Double session day — gym in the morning with chest and triceps (25 min), then beach volleyball in the evening (1h12). Good cross-training variety. The volleyball adds cardio and agility without running-specific load.
did_right: Good cross-training variety mixing gym and sport
Beach volleyball adds cardio, agility and lateral movement patterns
to_improve: Ensure adequate recovery before the weekend — two sessions in one day adds fatigue
